integrity.proof_type: exact finite-group harmonic analysis plus elementary Ramanujan-sum arithmetic

scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the three-dimensional finite Heisenberg group over Z/nZ; no higher-dimensional or general two-step nilpotent extension is claimed.
Only endpoint ell-one and ell-infinity norms are determined.

An equivalent absolute Ramanujan-sum norm formula may exist in older number-theoretic or signal-processing literature under another normalization; the nonabelian degree-layer identification was not located in the inspected sources.
The 2014 Ramanujan-subspace comparison used public metadata and abstract rather than a full-text inspection.
title: Ramanujan resolution of representation-degree layers in finite Heisenberg groups
